headline: Binance sentiment fell to 53 at 21:00, from a prior-week average of 80
dek: Sentiment fell hard for Binance, Tether and Bybit and barely moved for BNB or Bitcoin. In the sampled posts the crowd split close to evenly; official reassurance kept the score above 50.

key_numbers.label: positive share, sampled crowd excluding officials

narrative: Opinion on Binance dropped fast but did not collapse. Sentiment is the engagement-weighted share of non-neutral engagement that was positive, 0 to 100. Binance averaged 80 across the 162 baseline hours and never fell below 76 in the prior week. It read 67 at 20:00, 53 at 21:00 (the week's lowest hourly reading), then 58, 61 and 57. Oct 29 UTC scored 63 for the day, against post-event lows of 48 for Bybit in Feb 2025, 32 for Binance in Nov 2022 and 29 for FTX.

The tilt was broad and shallow. In the 686 sampled posts, 275 scored below neutral on the 1 to 5 post scale and carried 17.2M engagements, 31 percent of sampled engagement; only 78 scored below 2.8, with 3.9M. The most negative high-reach posts restated tracker estimates: @Kalshi_Crypto's 21:43 "over $5.6B stolen" (138K) scored 2.14. "Largest hack" carried a sentiment of 13 on X across 403 posts; "user funds are safe" carried 89 across 1,636 posts and 7.3M engagements.

Official posts supplied much of the positive weight. In the sample, official accounts (Binance, @cz_binance, @heyibinance, Tether's CEO) drew 10.4M positive-scored engagements and no negative ones; CZ's 21:15 post (3.2M) scored 3.27. Elon Musk's two sampled posts added 3.0M positive, including "Everyday is Zeroday". Without them the crowd split almost exactly even: 17.4M positive, 17.2M negative, a 50 percent share. Small accounts leaned negative, 3.4M against 1.6M.
Distrust was targeted. Tether fell from a prior-week 83 to 59 at 22:00 and USDC from 85 to 71 by 00:00. Bybit fell from 75 to 47 at 22:00 as "bybit hack" posts rose from 19 to 163.

The crowd separated the exchange from its token and from other exchanges. BNB stayed between 78 and 81 every event hour; Bitcoin moved from 69 to a low of 66 and the crypto category from 74 to 71. Kraken rose from 81 to about 91 and OKX from 77 to 80.

By network, Reddit was most negative at 51 over 24 hours, against 67 on X and TikTok, 70 on YouTube and 76 on Instagram; news scored 61 on 12 posts. Sampled Reddit posts averaged 2.86 on the 1 to 5 scale against 2.99 on X. For three full hours after the low, Binance sentiment held between 57 and 61.

callouts.title: Reassurance is carrying the score
callouts.body: Official accounts supplied 10.4M positive-scored engagements in the sampled posts and no negative ones; without them and Elon Musk's two posts, the sampled crowd split about evenly. Binance's 53 to 61 band rests partly on its own messaging.

callouts.title: BNB's own score did not move
callouts.body: BNB's sentiment stayed between 78 and 81 in event hours, against a prior-week 79, while the Binance topic fell to 53. BNB's price fell about 6 percent from 20:15 to 20:50, per CoinMarketCap via CryptoTicker.
